observations: Two vintage treadle sewing machine stands photographed outdoors on concrete and dirt
Left stand has a blue painted top with a rectangular machine cutout
Right stand has a wood-grain laminate top with a rectangular machine cutout
Cast iron legs with treadle foot pedals and drive wheels visible on both stands
No sewing machine heads are mounted on either stand
Ruler scale markings visible along the front edge of the blue table in photo 2
Watermark "SESHMAK TECH" overlaid across all photos

claims.evidence: photo 0-3 show treadle sewing machine stands
photos show sewing machine treadle stands, not weaving equipment
location cannot be confirmed from photos

risks.proof: photo or statement confirming whether machine heads are included or excluded
risks.if_unproven: priced as stands only without heads

risks.risk: Cast iron frame cracks or severe rust at joints
risks.proof: close-up photos of leg joints, treadle assembly, and frame welds
video of treadle wheel and pedal moving freely

risks.risk: Wood top rot, cracks, or water damage
risks.proof: close-up photos of wood surface and edges

proof_requests: Close-up of treadle wheel and belt mechanism
Close-up of cast iron leg joints for cracks or rust
Close-up of wood top surface condition
Video showing treadle pedal and wheel operation
response.reason: The items are identifiable as vintage sewing machine treadle stands from the photos, so they can be priced at their worst case as incomplete stands without machine heads.
